programme.title: 奇異地球 #4
programme.desc: 窺探確保物種在野外互利共生的奇特聯盟。探索小丑魚和海葵之間的夥伴關係,觀察牛椋鳥如何保持草原居民的健康,並揭開糞金龜和豬籠草之間的互利關係。

programme.title: 野性之最紐西蘭 #5
programme.desc: 紐西蘭與世隔絕的島嶼是不凡的天堂及家園,以擁有多元又獨特的野生動物聞名。尤以不會飛的鳥類、古代爬行類和沿海哺乳類最為人所共知,仔細觀察將會發現另一個世界。這裡有微型的怪物、小型的掠奪者和微小的恐怖,卻帶來了非凡的生命。每個獵人也是獵物﹐永遠需要努力生存。走進灌木叢,又會發現不同規模的生活。從巨型肉食蜈蚣和夜行蟋蟀到捕魚蛛和使用絲質陷阱的發光蠕蟲。奇怪而奇妙,這些無名英雄是野性紐西蘭最令人毛骨悚然的爬行類。

programme.title: 美國野生邊界: 北部揭祕
programme.desc: 沿著美加之間最長的邊境,野生動物猶如同時活在兩個世界。動物在障礙和矛盾的規則間如履薄冰,一念天堂一念地獄。

programme.title: 深入印度 #3
programme.desc: 拉達克高原是一片極端之地,但西藏野驢是這片草原的王者。跟隨一匹影響一群雌性的種馬,她有機會繁殖下一代,但若然如此,她必須與那些想要牠皇冠的對手作戰!

programme.title: 美洲豹日誌 #3
programme.desc: 跟隨科學家團隊在雨季過後重新走入美洲豹領地,進行一次具規模的搜索,以尋找菲琳娜、菲拉和巴達洛,因為他們的追蹤項圈已經丟失。迎接一位生物學家加入團隊,在他的協助下,麗茲·戴利為美洲豹重新安裝追蹤項圈,並添置高科技設備以記錄更多數據。

programme.title: 不羈尚比亞 #1
programme.desc: 在盧安瓜谷有一片烏木樹林,是一群狒狒的家園。但這裡存在著危險 - 與其他掠食者不同,同為居民的獵豹具有足夠的強大和敏捷性來爬樹。牠不是容易逃避的敵人。

programme.title: 狂野天空 #2
programme.desc: 仰望北美洲的天際,體驗強大而絢麗的自然現象。見證北極熊在極光下尋找食物,追蹤極地渦旋的冰冷路徑,並跟隨草原犬鼠家族躲避猛烈的龍捲風。

programme.title: 動物小兒科 #1
programme.desc: 大部分動物嬰兒都有母親撫養,並向牠們示範如何成功在野外生存。哺乳類動物特別依賴牠們的媽媽。本集的動物小兒科中,我們將遇到四種不同種類的嬰兒,牠們被人類撫養,還擁有代孕家庭。

programme.title: 狂野天空 #3
programme.desc: 到非洲窺探野生動物終生不懈的尋找水源之旅。見證地球上最壯觀的海洋覓食狂潮、了解眼鏡蛇的太陽能儲備,並跟隨牛羚與大象家族踏上壯闊的遷徙之旅。

programme.title: 狗建奇工 #5
programme.desc: 狗隻在本集利用其出色的嗅覺進行拯救生命和積極地保護環境治安的工作。在加拿大,一隊偵緝犬正在嗅探破壞性的入侵物種斑馬貽貝,這些貽貝對北美的湖泊和河流造成嚴重破壞。

programme.title: 海灘「龜」來記
programme.desc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」。本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底。

programme.title: 深入印度 #4
programme.desc: 在灼熱和充滿熱帶風暴的土地上,印度南部平原的生活十分艱苦。但一頭帶著兩隻幼崽的雌性樹懶比比,正迎接她生活上的挑戰,她每刻都要對抗缺水缺糧和掠食者。

programme.title: 美洲豹日誌 #4
programme.desc: 經歷風暴、洪水和停電,莉茲和獸醫霍亞雷斯仍奮力為更多美洲豹戴上項圈,情勢相當緊張。一起尋找巴達洛的下落,並嘗試在追蹤標籤掉落之前找到他,以及拜訪一隻團隊渴望研究的新䧳豹。

programme.title: 巨型長毛象的足跡
programme.desc: 這具百萬年歷史的巨大杜爾福長毛象骨骸,急需進行世界首創的緊急修復。我們跟隨這個艱钜的拆卸和重組脆弱化石的過程。透過電腦成像技術(CGI)和博物館知識,這部影片讓這個引人入勝卻鮮為人知的巨型生物重獲「生命」。

programme.title: 貓頭鷹的秘密生活 #1
programme.desc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春、夏、冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族。

programme.title: 貓頭鷹的秘密生活 #2
programme.desc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春、夏、冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #2
programme.desc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命。在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓。

programme.title: 大衛艾登堡: 自然本色 #2
programme.desc: 大衛艾登堡揭示大自然中一些最狡猾的騙子和偽裝大師。發掘一些動物如何使用顏色隱藏並消失在背景中,或是耍詭計和欺騙。

programme.title: 大衛艾登堡: 自然本色 #3
programme.desc: 找出對動物顏色的科學研究背後的故事—從機械青蛙到現實世界對應物種間的角力,到蜘蛛畫眼線來吸引配偶。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #1
programme.desc: 春天來臨。北約克沼澤國家公園裡的動物必須尋找食物、配偶,並組織家庭。

programme.title: 美國道地料理大搜查 #7
programme.desc: 1975年越戰結束後,許多越南人在三藩市定居。我們在本集遇上幾位越南移民,瞭解他們的美國之旅,並品嚐他們那些令人驚嘆的正宗越南美食。

programme.title: 美國道地料理大搜查 #8
programme.desc: 沒有其他菜餚比義大利菜對現代菜系有如此大影響。大批義大利人來到這裡,並直接開工。他們現在受到所有人的喜愛,但並非一直如此。

programme.title: 美國道地料理大搜查 #9
programme.desc: 信不信由你,在波斯尼亞戰爭期間,有超過70,000名波斯尼亞人移民至聖路易。縱使他們熱愛他們的新國家,但也帶來了一些美國人認為有些奇怪的習俗,然而他們的食物卻非常美味。

programme.title: 美國道地料理大搜查 #10
programme.desc: 在多年的殖民統治中,美國從定居的移民那裡鑽研他們的食物。現在有一種叫做「美國」的美食,十分好吃。

programme.title: 美國道地料理大搜查 #11
programme.desc: 發掘一種文化的根源總是很有趣。我們追蹤非裔美國人在美麗的新奧爾良定居的歷史。

programme.title: 美國道地料理大搜查 #12
programme.desc: 這種移動趨勢正席捲各州,同時將食物帶給人們。我們跟上大隊,並品嚐美食。

programme.title: 夏奇拉: 新時代女性
programme.desc: 講述唱片銷量超過1億哥倫比亞出生的超級巨星莎琦拉的故事;還有她堅定不移的倡議和慈善努力,使她成為有類似志向的藝人和粉絲的榜樣。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #1
programme.desc: 祖拜登於2021年1月20日就任美國第46任總統,承諾在分裂的時代後團結和鎮靜,目標是「恢復美國魂」。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #2
programme.desc: 當川普的總統任期(2017-2021)在一片爭議和社會變革中過渡,對國家和世界產生了良久影響。

programme.title: 灰熊的故事: 雙孤記
programme.desc: 凱西安達臣撫養一隻名叫砵突士的熊孤兒18年後,將盡一切努力確保沒有熊生活在人造庇護所中。有一年,當他得知有兩隻灰熊幼崽成為孤兒後,他的決心受到考驗。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #1
programme.desc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了獨特的野生生態。從南部的西班牙栓皮櫟森林到北部的落葉林,從交配到野外生存,跟隨標誌性物種所經歷的關鍵生命階段。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #2
programme.desc: 河流是葡萄牙野生生態的生命線,連接山脈到大海。探索成年雄鹿、青蛙的春季儀式和鸊鷉的舞蹈,還有這些生機勃勃的水道沿岸上其他動物和地貌。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #3
programme.desc: 葡萄牙沿海水域和亞速爾群島擁有豐富的生態系統。在本集探索生活在這些水域的多元化物種,並發掘牠們獨特的生活。

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #1
programme.desc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛。

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #2
programme.desc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然。三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #2
programme.desc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往智利偏遠的阿塔卡馬沙漠,到訪地球上最令人難以置信、最複雜的天文臺之一- ALMA。他與ALMA的專家團一起修復一些世上最大的天線。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #3
programme.desc: 全球疫情導致世上唯一的水底棲息地停運。米克大衛臣加入裂縫修復小組,一同潛入水中修復它,並讓美國太空總署的太空人返回內部進行訓練。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #4
programme.desc: 米克大衛臣加入正準備接受試驗的美國海軍陸戰隊的「重型運輸機」中隊。他們致力保持CH53「超級種馬」直升機機隊飛行,為在沙漠和山區進行激戰的訓練演習作準備。

programme.title: 俯瞰義大利 #3
programme.desc: 它們的形狀和大小各適其適,是可怕的火山、偉大的古代文明,還有地球上最清澈水域的家。它們就是迷人的義大利島國。

programme.title: 俯瞰義大利 #4
programme.desc: 這裡擁有地中海一些最美麗的希臘神廟、似乎漂浮在海上的城市,還有地球上其中一個威力最大的火山,義大利這地區感覺就如平行世界。

programme.desc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命。在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #3
programme.desc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量。這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #1
programme.desc: 春天來臨。北約克沼澤國家公園裡的動物必須尋找食物、配偶,並組織家庭。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #2
programme.desc: 反常的寒冷夏天令約克郡谷地和北約克沼澤國家公園的幾種動物生活艱難,其中包括一隻受傷的西方麅和她的雙胞胎。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #3
programme.desc: 夏季持續,秋天暫且未到,出人意料的宜人天氣為西方麅們提供了一條救命稻草,因牠們正為即將到來的冬季做準備。至於其他動物,交配季節已到,在文斯卡海灘充滿了睾酮的氣息。

programme.title: 美國道地料理大搜查 #11
programme.desc: 發掘一種文化的根源總是很有趣。我們追蹤非裔美國人在美麗的新奧爾良定居的歷史。

programme.title: 神秘的英國 2 #1
programme.desc: 克萊夫安德森和瑪麗安奧喬塔嘗試找出一個古老戰士部落神秘消失的原因,並揭露維京人、巨人和尼斯湖水怪的傳奇故事。

programme.title: 神秘的英國 2 #2
programme.desc: 克萊夫安德森和瑪麗安奧喬塔探索一幅神秘的巨型山丘畫,並被古代神話、當地的民間傳說和異教徒儀式所吸引。是誰出於甚麼原因把它放在那裡?

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #2
programme.desc: 當川普的總統任期(2017-2021)在一片爭議和社會變革中過渡,對國家和世界產生了良久影響。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #3
programme.desc: 巴拉克歐巴馬是首位非裔美國總統,體現了希望、正義、寬容和平等,以他的資訊和傳承啟發數百萬人。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #4
programme.desc: 探索比爾柯林頓複雜的影響,從阿肯色州起家到白宮的高山(經濟繁榮)與低谷(醜聞、彈劾),以及他對美國政治的影響。

programme.title: 芭比的故事
programme.desc: 芭比娃娃在2024年慶祝65歲生日。但她不僅是一塊12英寸長的塑膠或一個玩具。 這位傳奇金髮美女已成為一種現象和小孩們的寵兒。

programme.title: 碧昂絲: 鄉村音樂女王
programme.desc: 關注碧昂絲諾爾斯卡特的人生和事業,從她早年擔任組合「天命真女」主唱到現在的單飛生涯。探討這位超級巨星多年來的音樂風格和靈感是如何演變的。

programme.title: 大衛艾登堡: 地球上的一段生命旅程
programme.desc: 大衛艾登堡爵士是一位傳奇的傳播者和教育家,在過去六十多年裡遊歷全球,用他那引人入勝的說故事技巧啟發數百萬人,並將自然世界帶入我們家中。

programme.title: 珍娜·傑克森: 誘惑的藝術
programme.desc: 珍妮積遜以其強烈的獨立性、有吸力的氣質和迷人的嗓音而聞名,她在MTV的成長成為她的催化劑;接受她的身份,並到達明星的巔峰。

programme.title: ABBA樂團: 歐洲歌唱大賽後的半世紀
programme.desc: 從頭記錄ABBA由歐洲歌唱大賽到崛起成全球巨星、他們標誌性的嗓音、破紀錄的成功、單飛的努力、ABBA精選唱片- Gold的復甦,以及先進的全息投影巡演- 《啟航》,樂隊以虛擬形式重聚。

programme.title: 揭秘芭比: 分裂的夢幻屋
programme.desc: 《揭秘芭比: 分裂的夢幻屋》揭示創作芭比娃娃背後的戲劇性真實故事,重點講述聯合創作者羅絲韓德勒和傑克瑞恩的高山與低谷,以及他們標誌性又備受爭議發明的持久影響。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #5
programme.desc: 本紀錄片審視喬治小布希的總統任期,尤其是伊拉克戰爭、其後遺症以及他的決定帶來的持久影響,包括伊斯蘭國的崛起和衝突造成的傷亡。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #6
programme.desc: 朗奴雷根是一位有魅力的領袖,他用列根經濟學將美國轉營,在國內外有著不同意見,又用他富有遠見的政策和標誌性的演講永遠改變保守主義。

programme.desc: 這具百萬年歷史的巨大杜爾福長毛象骨骸,急需進行世界首創的緊急修復。我們跟隨這個艱钜的拆卸和重組脆弱化石的過程。透過電腦成像技術(CGI)和博物館知識,這部影片讓這個引人入勝卻鮮為人知的巨型生物重獲「生命」。

programme.title: 貓頭鷹的秘密生活 #1
programme.desc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春、夏、冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族。

programme.title: 貓頭鷹的秘密生活 #2
programme.desc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春、夏、冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族。

programme.title: 神秘的英國 2 #2
programme.desc: 克萊夫安德森和瑪麗安奧喬塔探索一幅神秘的巨型山丘畫,並被古代神話、當地的民間傳說和異教徒儀式所吸引。是誰出於甚麼原因把它放在那裡?

programme.title: 神秘的英國 2 #3
programme.desc: 克萊夫安德森和瑪麗安奧喬塔前往奧克尼群島,進入傳說中的巨怪巢穴,以調查一宗維京人寶藏、慾望和瘋狂案件。

programme.title: 神秘的英國 2 #4
programme.desc: 德魯伊是史前嬉皮士還是嗜血的人類祭獻怪醫?克萊夫安德森和瑪麗安奧喬塔探索安格爾西島,研究人食人,並面對熾熱的柳條人。

programme.title: 太空災難 #6
programme.desc: 將太空船送入軌道是一項不容有錯的工作。每次發射都是長時間的受控爆炸,最小的誤差可導致火爆的處境。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #1
programme.desc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往巴西,一群巨型發電船正處於解決當地逼切的電力需求的最後階段。它們對抗風浪,趕在限期前為200萬戶家庭提供盡可能多的電力。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #2
programme.desc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往智利偏遠的阿塔卡馬沙漠,到訪地球上最令人難以置信、最複雜的天文臺之一- ALMA。他與ALMA的專家團一起修復一些世上最大的天線。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #5
programme.desc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡羅瓦的一座鮭魚養殖場,瞭解紐西蘭帝王鮭與大西洋鮭的不同之處。他親自捕撈鮭魚,並在俯瞰港灣的海岸邊烹調。他也介紹了一款高品質的本地食用油,兼具健康與多功能性,體現對本地農業與永續的承諾。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #6
programme.desc: 正值核果盛產季節!Ben 造訪中奧塔哥一個由家族經營的果園,該果園以核果產季長、與土地及社區的緊密連結而聞名。他發現了一座全電力運作的櫻桃農場,將優質外銷櫻桃直接販售給紐西蘭民眾。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #7
programme.desc: Ben 體驗魯阿佩胡地區正崛起的飲食文化,以及悠久的市集園藝歷史。他拜訪了一位第六代農夫,該農夫將一片偏遠荒野打造成繁榮的生態旅遊與高級餐飲目的地,並與一位屢獲殊榮的主廚合作。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #1
programme.desc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開。他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程。Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用。

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #1
programme.desc: 在聖露西亞,雙胞胎驚喜現身梅茜的度假之旅,帆船探險、叢林健行、極致享受的巧克力按摩、蘭姆酒品鑑,熱帶樂趣無限延伸!

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #2
programme.desc: 在冰島,邦妮與雙胞胎展開史詩冒險——賞鯨、火山健行、策馬奔馳,還有極光下的深度環保對話。

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #3
programme.desc: 在杜拜,路克全力挑戰腎上腺素極限: 潛水探險、水上飛行器、揮桿高爾夫、快艇狂飆——最後邊晚餐邊暢聊《哈利波特》回憶,輸家買單!

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #4
programme.desc: 在波蘭,蘇菲拋下寧靜假期,換來滿滿刺激: 征服壯麗塔特拉山、漂流急湍河道、探訪傳奇鹽礦,精彩不間斷!

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #6
programme.desc: 朗奴雷根是一位有魅力的領袖,他用列根經濟學將美國轉營,在國內外有著不同意見,又用他富有遠見的政策和標誌性的演講永遠改變保守主義。

programme.title: 菲力浦: 親王、丈夫、父親
programme.desc: 正如女王所說,菲臘親王不會「輕易接受讚美」。這齣電影盡可能地讓菲臘親王替自己說話,利用公爵罕見的檔案和錄音談論他自己的人生和作為 。

programme.title: 亞瑟: 皇家生活
programme.desc: 亞瑟在四十多年來拍攝主要王室成員的照片,不僅與他們建立了工作關係,並跟國王查爾斯三世和王后成了朋友。

programme.title: 非洲的空中歷險 #1
programme.desc: 沿著非洲南部海岸觀賞古老的海蝕洞、現代的高爾夫球場、神秘的地質構造和危險的掠食者。

programme.title: 非洲的空中歷險 #2
programme.desc: 從空中俯瞰南非的山脈、繁囂的都市和野性難馴的動物。這是南非從史前骨頭到現代摩天大廈的旅程。

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: At an address in the Wirral, Inspector Anthony Joynes finds two collie crosses, Patch and Socks Both dogs are in very poor condition and Anthony needs to get them out Inspector Herchy Boal is called to Scooby's rescue She's collapsed with puncture wounds after fighting with two other dogs Scooby is in shock so she needs urgent medical care

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South AmericaThey have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone

programme.title: 海賊王 #1
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第1季) #7
programme.desc: 拉納克將四大國聯合軍視為敵人,企圖支配整個大陸。奧斯卡在塔伊利國碰上暗中來與魯斯托王子交涉的緹娜夏,得知她正竭盡所能降低戰況所造成的損害。拉納克邀請奧斯卡等人前來已滅亡的鐸洱達爾國大聖堂遺址,打算使用緹娜夏的魔力,完成監控大陸全境的術式。

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第1季) #8
programme.desc: 打敗拉納克後,奧斯卡為了視察而與緹娜夏一同前往位於國境的米內達堡壘。附近的村莊遭受騎馬民族「伊圖」的殺戮與掠奪,因此喪夫的村長夫人愛爾澤也投靠於此。當「伊圖」首領哈維前來搶奪愛爾澤時,奧斯卡雖在決鬥中獲勝,卻與緹娜夏捲進了突發的異變中。

programme.desc: 拉納克將四大國聯合軍視為敵人,企圖支配整個大陸。奧斯卡在塔伊利國碰上暗中來與魯斯托王子交涉的緹娜夏,得知她正竭盡所能降低戰況所造成的損害。拉納克邀請奧斯卡等人前來已滅亡的鐸洱達爾國大聖堂遺址,打算使用緹娜夏的魔力,完成監控大陸全境的術式。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #9
programme.desc: 兔耳山深信只要打贏梅宮,獲得防風鈴與自由,就能變得比誰都要「快樂」。他乘勢持續攻擊梅宮,卻沒有對他造成絲毫傷害。無法理解梅宮所說的「你的拳頭太弱,因為沒有背負任何東西」的兔耳山,在受到梅宮全力一擊後,浮現腦海的是開懷大笑的獅子頭連成員們。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #10
programme.desc: 面對認輸而打算交出獅子頭連的兔耳山,梅宮不僅說出「從今天起我們就是朋友啦」,甚至還開起了慶功宴,現場氣氛讓人無法想像剛才兩方的鬥爭。櫻雖然感到混亂,但也因此與表達懺悔之意的十龜及兔耳山成功交談。如此種種讓櫻心中對「頂點」的看法產生了變化。

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #12
programme.desc: 即將開戰之際,拉格納聽完絲塔莉亞保護同伴的覺悟後,找到了自己在這場戰鬥的目標,並帶著全新的決心將銀氣注入劍中。絲塔莉亞則因初次目睹拉格納壓倒性的力量,體認到自己仍不夠成熟,發誓要讓自己繼續成長。在各方決意交錯中,一決生死的戰鬥揭開了序幕。

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #13
programme.desc: 各地戰況越演越烈之下,銀裝兵團憑著絲塔莉亞壓倒性的領袖魅力,克服了奧魯特佐拉的卑劣攻擊,並主動攻入森林。另一方面,拉格納與達拉迪克多拉展開一場激戰,連周圍地貌都遭到改變。拉格納因無法如願擊敗敵人而感到焦躁,為了儘早分出勝負而使出全力一擊。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:所以,不要憂慮! 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 福音電影: 最危險人物
programme.desc: 「一代賊王」葉繼歡今晨於瑪麗醫院羈留病房因癌症病逝,終年55歲。 這個曾經手持AK47在街上亂槍掃射、令人聞風喪膽的賊王在被捕、越獄後再犯案。一次偷渡回港時,中槍被捕,成為半身癱瘓的囚犯。 葉繼歡於2004年歸信耶穌,2010年更親筆回信給《天使心》。 今天,小編在整理葉繼歡的書信時,發現了這一句話

programme.title: 屬靈教室:蔡錦圖博士-小先知書的大意義
屬靈教室:劉銳光牧師-羅馬書
programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽

programme.title: 你是主角

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:鶼鰈情深 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 專題講座:張路加牧師宣教培靈系列
programme.desc: 華人福音工作是現今最大的禾場,我們需要怎樣的裝備,將福音的種子帶到華人當中?就讓擁有豐富牧會經驗的張路加牧師,教大家好好裝備,在福音的道路上奔跑吧。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大

programme.desc: 《今日說法》是一檔日播法治欄目,秉持“點滴記錄中國法治進程的理念,以“重在普法,監督執法,促進立法、服務百姓為宗旨,採用“以案說法、大眾參與、專家點評的節目樣式進行普法宣傳,被譽“中國人的法制午餐。節目前半部分呈現記者深入基層採訪的真實案例,後半部分由演播室中的主持人和嘉賓對節目進行點評,體現節目品質和社會價值。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 匠心築未來粵
高朋滿座#25粵
programme.desc: 有朋為女兒製造在「紀念匯演」演出機會，與悅滿一齊討好家長會，可惜表演主角卻非蕙婷，而是大陳太的愛女。悅滿踢爆大陳太的陰私，令蕙婷連配角的位置也失去，悅滿於是發起「瑜珈示威」，逼使家長會進行公平試鏡。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#36粵普PG
programme.desc: 臨波求娶冬青為妻。錢明在同窗秦致遠引薦下，牽線仙綾閣與南方做生意。仙綾閣被查出和海盜勾結走私，皇上震怒，十一娘等人被拘，簡師傅更受了重刑。閣老勸令宜以大局為重，休妻自保。令宜追查到關鍵證人秦致遠已死。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 潮州民間有「無鵝不成席」的請客傳統，足見鵝在潮菜中地位超然。主持們來到鵝場一睹馳名「獅頭鵝」真貌；另在雅致餐廳邊吃邊談「粗菜精做」的烹飪智慧。炮製豬油要講究，方可確保「芋頭豬油渣炒飯」甘香爽口，到底這道經典菜怎樣體現鼎爺的功架？「素菜葷做」能為平凡菜式提升滋味層次，鼎爺示範以金華火腿、老雞等豐富食材熬製高湯，令看似簡單的「大芥菜燜冬菇」味道昇華。剩湯再煮出鮮美「頂湯浸沙錐魚」，七分鐘即可「加餸」！

programme.title: 匠心築未來粵
programme.desc: 星級藝員阮浩棕親身前往工地，向建造業不同工種的師傅、專才請教及學習，了解燒焊、釘板、紮鐵、混凝土、批盪、油漆、玻璃幕牆、工程監督，各個崗位的工作日常，以及如何善用新科技輔助並完善工序，讓觀眾感受行內專業盡責的匠心、匠技、匠魂與匠行精神。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 阿茲海默症是最主要的認知障礙症種類，成因源於腦內積聚「廢物」，逐步影響腦細胞，早期症狀包括短期記憶力下降、語言能力及執行能力變差。不過，正電子掃描檢查，有助診斷出早期阿茲海默症，讓患者盡早接受治療，專科醫生到臨詳析相關資訊。鄧達智這次帶大王、秀怡走進灣仔船街，享用西班牙菜。除了乳鴿飯與特色蛋餅，眾人亦品嚐具西班牙特色的一口小吃，感受異國風味。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐炮製「芋香蝦球蘿蔔糕」，鮮香惹味。

programme.title: 健康必殺食粵
programme.desc: 可吃到喜歡的食物就是快樂？健康食物通常不快樂？攝取含色胺酸的食物可轉化為血清素，是予人快樂的因子。蜂蜜放進美食、特飲中，好殺食！六號帶趙希洛、黃美棋、曾淑雅勇闖蜂場，採集天然蜂蜜，並帶來蜂蜜食用宜忌。三文魚等深海魚含豐富DHA，主持們到北歐餐廳品嚐「快樂」，還轉往農莊採摘新鮮番茄、西蘭花，再由陳國強炮製海鮮好滋味。不少港人備受壓力，難免影響快樂指數。結合玫瑰花、草本成分的紓壓寧神茶，有助調節心情。

programme.title: 陪著你走#18粵
programme.desc: 德波告訴言重「愛是IV」廣告改為「我是無所不能I」。林詠辭職，臨走前為他彈鋼琴並記錄在記憶棒。言重把記憶棒留在加勁房間……林Sir見天從認真跑步，替她報名跑十公里賽。言重致電天從，得到啟發橋如泉湧……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子摘了秋櫻回家，爺爺帶她去買花瓶，但因為不夠錢作罷，小丸子於是把汽水瓶拿回去插花。小玉因被父親纏著拍照而煩惱，小丸子建議讓他去找其他拍攝對象，最終把目標定為鎮上的老人家。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 芭菲精靈一覺醒來，匆匆迎接一眾零食小兵，並以「廠長話」遊戲測試他們的服從度。兩隊起初表現穩定，但當小兵們單腳企及舉起一隻手後，甫聽到「放低手腳」的指令就鬆懈了，竟接連失手，雙方隨即分出勝負。收集水果任務，薯片小兵幾次踏入果園都觸碰到障礙物，不過只要不灰心，還是可以完成任務的！最後，芭菲精靈要求大家於溶化之橋上運送雪糕球，有隊伍一開始就大膽挑戰六球，也有隊伍採取循序漸進策略，結果如何？

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 新學期開始，亂太郎要返回忍術學校，家人依依不捨。亂太郎與新丁他們匯合之後，新丁講述自己在休假期間發生過的事。抵達忍術學校之後，小丸突然說因為惹怒了土井老師，所以不敢進入學校。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 銀屑病，俗稱「牛皮癬」，是一種非傳染性、慢性自身免疫系統疾病，是由於免疫系統異常，導致皮膚細胞過度增生，形成患者皮膚上一片片，帶有銀白色鱗屑的紅色斑塊，看起來十分粗糙乾燥，常見於頭皮、手肘、膝蓋等，嚴重時可蔓延至全身，除了影響生活品質，亦可能併發關節炎。目前只可透過藥物、光療等方法控制。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 匠心築未來粵
programme.desc: 星級藝員阮浩棕親身前往工地，向建造業不同工種的師傅、專才請教及學習，了解燒焊、釘板、紮鐵、混凝土、批盪、油漆、玻璃幕牆、工程監督，各個崗位的工作日常，以及如何善用新科技輔助並完善工序，讓觀眾感受行內專業盡責的匠心、匠技、匠魂與匠行精神。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 事主投訴被屯門某工廈升降機夾傷手，工廈一方的態度卻欠積極，還指應向升降機工程公司追討，惟工程公司又以不同藉口推諉。跟進拒收鄰居婦人食物而遭報復事件，原來其他住戶都曾受過滋擾，更談及婦人的往事。外景主持親訪婦人家了解情況，對方卻於交談期間逐漸失控，更拿起鐵鎚，場面觸目驚心。《中年好聲音4》上演殘酷「一對一PK賽」，蒙面藝員「貓女郎」再度登場，表現獲讚賞。有銀行與醫院合作，如何照顧客戶的不同健康需要？

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2732粵
programme.desc: Ceci新購入的跑車佔用了家聰的車位，家聰被迫將剛修護過的愛車停泊在別處，竟因此招致損毀。其後，Ceci發現跑車的座椅遭煙頭焯損，遂要求力蓮、尚善於三日內查出真兇。碰巧監控錄像系統故障，二人便着Ivan盡快修復，同時指派保安部篩查疑兇。家聰嫌疑最大，並承認自己確有犯錯，但是……Ceci揚言要控告家聰，家聰遂打算找Ceci作個了斷。另一邊廂，監控錄像終於修復，尚善與力蓮發現真相出乎意料……

programme.title: 非常檢控觀#7粵PG
programme.desc: 藝術系研究生饒馨儀請求希仁幫忙，調查其陶藝家父親饒英拔懷疑遭殺害之事。赤盆曾由英拔修復，經化驗後證實盆上有屬於英拔的血液反應。眾人追查赤盆來源，查到買家是古董商人葉志健，賣家竟是龐喆，希仁遂試探龐喆……馨儀終讓眾人聽到英拔冤魂發聲，英拔道出兇手身分，馨儀聽後感驚惶。熊飛遭從前的手下艾俠與陳立新打傷，逸桐為他包紮傷口，二人共度整夜。馨儀似有隱暪，公孫珀、熊飛查到馨儀與教授何遠程疑有不可告人的秘密……

programme.title: 宿敵契約#26粵普PG
programme.desc: 隨歌手刃慕容曜為一眾將士報仇，承陽決定退位，與母后為平城守陵，隨歌到錦繡想接回戲陽，寧非過來與他們會合，戲陽向隨歌道明懷了靜炎的骨肉，靜炎要求戲陽陪他過生辰就會放她回夙砂，生辰當天靜石帶著人到宮中…

programme.title: 聚大金鳳呈獻:在家宴客60道菜粵
programme.desc: 蛋汁意粉是西餐的基本菜式，西廚積奇以中式臘肉取代煙肉。出品賣相金黃亮麗，符合中國人喜愛的好意頭。鼎爺帶來惹味的醬香骨，將冰糖炒成糖色，為菜式添上一層焦香，箇中有何技巧？肥媽貼心考量客人健康，構思並示範以素食的黑松露繽紛拌飯宴客。她用藜麥、芋頭、椰菜花、腰果等食材入饌，為拌飯增加豐富口感與層次。遼參矜貴，用來請客更顯體面。許美德師傅以蝦膠釀遼參，還於中間加入另一種食材來增添肉汁，會是甚麼？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 名媛望族#31粵
programme.desc: 達志向卓萬提親，浩頤感動，願意嫁給達志。卓萬提出讓達志入贅，浩頤拒絕。卓萬指浩頤只能在他與達志之中選其一，浩頤左右為難，卓萬乘勢叫她不要嫁，浩頤失望。小由發覺木水對啟燊變本加厲，啟燊安慰她，小由內疚。

programme.title: 家家行運菜粵
programme.desc: 在香港仔避風塘仍有不少漁民過着傳統水上人的生活，他們有何特別的新年習俗？主持麥長青、王君馨和吳業坤「驛馬星動」，來到一個小「漁村」，「偷師」學習如何用大地魚湯炮製溫暖的糯米飯，一起品嚐漁村風味的賀年宴！如何才可炸出香口的合桃？今集「迎新年八件事」有大廚馮嘉橋，示範炮製令人食指大動的賀年小吃「琥珀合桃」。江美儀到來用平凡的粟米、魚柳和蝦，送上「粟米黃金塊」和「招財進寶茄汁蝦」，令大家大飽口福！

programme.title: 家家行運菜粵
programme.desc: 今集麥長青、王君馨和吳業坤走到打鼓嶺，體會農夫如何割禾，並品嚐別有一番風味的農家菜「蘿蔔炆大鱔」和「紅菜頭雜菜湯」！今集的「行運」嘉賓，是近年轉戰內地的馬浚偉「馬仔」，曾擔任美食節目主持的他，會在節目中大顯身手，炮製一道馬家獨有的「一馬當先黃金帶子」！廚藝不錯的「馬仔」所煮的這道菜，可否滿足主持們的「五臟廟」？「迎新年八件事」的第二件事是在家中添置充滿節日氣氛的賀年裝飾，三位主持有何新潮的建議？

programme.desc: 靖遠侯向彥行坦白一切，若要救十一娘及徐家，區家所有人便會死無葬身之地，彥行感到猶豫。十一娘在會審時呈上和離書，與徐家撇清關係，獨力承擔罪名。在徐家眾人跪求下，皇上將十一娘刑期延後，令宜竭力尋找證據。

阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 普寧豆醬是潮汕的特產，潮州「打冷」菜式「黃腳鱲配普寧豆醬」，就以鹹香的豆醬帶出魚的鮮味。鼎爺加以參考，巧製「普寧豆醬焗蟹」，阿譚更大讚醬料可減輕蟹膏的油膩感。鯽魚分黑、白，有何區別？豆豉有鹹、淡，用途又怎樣？鼎爺選用白鯽魚創出「豆豉鯽魚」，把魚炸香後趁熱淋上自家製豉汁，還要放於汁中浸逾五小時，魚肉加倍入味！潮州的手打魚蛋固然鮮甜彈牙，令阿譚念念不忘的「魚冊」又是甚麼？鼎爺帶拍檔見識魚冊的製作過程。

programme.title: 匠心築未來粵
programme.desc: 星級藝員阮浩棕親身前往工地，向建造業不同工種的師傅、專才請教及學習，了解燒焊、釘板、紮鐵、混凝土、批盪、油漆、玻璃幕牆、工程監督，各個崗位的工作日常，以及如何善用新科技輔助並完善工序，讓觀眾感受行內專業盡責的匠心、匠技、匠魂與匠行精神。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 乳癌是香港女性常見癌症之一，平均每十四位婦女中，就有一位可能患病，有何高危因素？外科醫生細說乳癌的期數與種類，卻指不是所有乳癌病人都要接受化療，並帶來相關的評估檢測及病例。腰椎間孔狹窄症是因椎間盤突出或骨刺壓住神經線，患者會出現腰痛、腿部麻痹甚至行動困難。脊醫提醒情況輕微可透過物理治療、針灸或運動改善，也會與主持一起示範有強化與舒緩作用的動作。「睇餸食飯」，李文星師傅烹調「蘿蔔燜牛腩」，香濃惹味。

programme.title: 健康必殺食粵
programme.desc: 納豆被指可延年益壽，秋葵是降三高恩物，山藥富膳食纖維，惟三者的獨特黏性與口感，令不少人感到抗拒。另外，部份人也覺得芫荽、西芹、生菜、火箭菜含有苦味、怪味，甚為反感。這集，衍峰帶領林凱恩、黃婧靈、戴祖儀走進「虛擬遊戲世界」做任務，一探「奇怪食物」的食用價值與功效。「重口味」食材經巧手烹調，即成滋味美饌。湛錦鈿奉上「有營」納豆炒飯與秋葵山藥蛋餅；另一廚藝達人陳曉樺則帶來砵酒燴牛脷及金菜頭豆渣可樂餅。

programme.title: 陪著你走#19粵
programme.desc: 星期六早上，言重帶菲菲、梁嬌和加勁來天從家，讓大家認識。言重與天從逛商場，遇上秀玄向何娜發表心聲。言重拖著天從回家，將天從的手放在自己頭上讓她撫摸。言重表示林Sir已替天從報名跑十公里，天從願意試跑。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子看見花輪的教科書劃了螢光筆很漂亮，便問他借來一用，好讓自己有動力溫習。小丸子發現永澤種了絲瓜田，細問之下得知對方要製作絲瓜擦，小丸子於是跟他學造絲瓜擦，以送給爺爺作生日���物。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 無論飼養甚麼動物，都應先了解牠們的習性，並為其設置合適的生活環境。動物義工團體代表指，即使龜相對容易照顧，也不可掉以輕心。他特意攜來多種水龜亮相「Kids’ Notes」，部份龜更因飼養不當或遭棄養而受傷。嘉賓介紹紅耳龜、真鱷龜等龜品種的特徵與習性，原來有些龜是不能將頭縮入殼內。為讓小朋友更容易理解，他還帶同這些龜種的年幼與成年版現身，並提醒有意飼養者，要預先規劃與思考龜於成長過程中所需的空間。

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 小松田被來歷不明的忍者邀請跳槽。亂太郎他們知道之後，協助小松田練習面試。瀧夜叉丸因為某種理由而不想飲麵豉湯，因而惹怒了飯堂大嬸。下雨令亂太郎他們不能出外玩。他們因此祈求上天停雨。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
programme.desc: 元朗新盤入伙，驗樓師發現，地腳線裂開，露台門遺漏防撞裝置，如何補救？

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2733粵
programme.desc: 虹豆沙湯遠成為大四喜的經理人，表現出色。鐵面陳暫代沙湯遠管理保安部，本可與Mia一同代表接龍出席某頒獎禮，怎料敢威臨時改回由沙湯遠出席。馬漢為鐵面陳獻計，意圖阻止沙湯遠出席，卻陰差陽錯反而令他「出盡風頭」。沙湯遠意外成為不少人心目中的男神，「人氣」甚至超越大四喜。大四喜遂找回家聰頂替沙湯遠，家聰卻發現雷公欲邀沙湯遠加盟雷聲大。大四喜既不容許放走沙湯遠，又擔心被他搶風頭，家聰於是提出一個解決方法……

programme.title: 非常檢控觀#8粵PG
programme.desc: 馨儀向希仁、公孫珀坦承自己受遠程利用，為他製作膺品。熊飛查到顏映朱的拍賣行可能出售非法走私古董，逸桐的義兄蔣平江也涉案被捕。希仁往找頌星，希望她出任平江的辯護律師……英拔冤魂引領馨儀、希仁等至一個工場外，終找到英拔的頭骨。遠程、映朱兩夫妻，此時與龐喆在工場的辦公室內密會，馨儀欲殺遠程報仇，希仁阻止而被馨儀刺傷！龐喆等人涉嫌謀殺英拔被捕，頌星出任龐喆的代表律師，但龐喆不信任她……

programme.title: 宿敵契約#27粵普PG
programme.desc: 靜炎受靜石折磨寧死不屈，卻為戲陽向靜石服軟，靜石刺傷戲陽，殺了靜炎，隨歌趕來帶戲陽求醫；靜石帶著靜炎屍體找太后，並毒殺她，靜石不信一笑會殺自己，一笑朝他射箭…靜石引隨歌和一笑等人到祖居，雙方展開激戰…

programme.title: 聚大金鳳呈獻:在家宴客60道菜粵
programme.desc: 三文魚肉都可以紮辮，肥媽教煮「手工藝」，並選以不同香草、橄欖與水果同焗，為三文魚注入香氣和口感層次。星哥亦帶來水果海鮮料理，香印提子配青口、蝦仁、鮮魷焗飯，份外香濃，嘉欣吃不停！水果入饌有何搭配貼士？煲仔菜是冬日滋味之選，鼎爺以柱侯醬、磨豉醬、麵豉醬等醬汁煀煮鮑魚雞煲，肉質嫩滑不柴，還添上一份暖意。用蛋絲、鹹蛋黃炒「金絲」，脆卜卜「麥皮蝦」更可連殼食？幟哥提到要將大蝦炸至香脆金黃，必需分三次油炸。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

名媛望族#32粵
programme.desc: 卓萬帶丹丹到舞會，百鏘對子君表示卓萬把卓萬山以丹丹名易名，要子君還他人情。以誠把首飾盒交卓萬，是贈子君的棋子連鏈，卓萬把首飾盒及易名鳳凰山文件放夾萬。啟燊夫婦往上海，木水趕至指卓萬是害小由父的罪魁。

programme.desc: 樓上「租霸」徐師奶殺入高家，原來有義收起了徐師奶的拖鞋。徐師奶在夜間遷出該址，留下寫滿詛咒的紙條。溢滿所編的詛咒發生在眾人身上，只得有朋及高麗「身免」。有朋查出全因眾人壞習慣，恐佈繡花鞋竟又再出現。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#38粵普PG
programme.desc: 徐令宜偽裝成黑衣人欲救十一娘，被靖遠候的人窮追不捨，幸得衛國公及彥行相助脫險，但十一娘已行刑在即…原來令宜已把證據呈交給皇上，靖遠候被判死罪，彥行則要流放塞外。仙綾閣名揚海外，十一娘被封一品誥命夫人。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 過年前趕緊辦年貨，主持們前往海味店，一探揀選花膠、鮑魚的學問，煲湯、燜煮各有好選擇！阿譚為氹鼎爺出手炮製賀年佳餚「花膠金蠔燜花菇」，不惜「豪購」優質花膠。除了事前浸焗花膠有竅門，燜煮花菇、金蠔、花膠的次序亦要講究。不少人愛吃豆苗，但阿譚吃得嘴刁，對更加幼嫩的豆胚情有獨鍾！烹調「雞油豆胚」期間，鼎爺竟勾起年少傷心事？眼見拍檔未盡興，鼎爺再奉上一道「冬瓜寶盒」。清甜的冬瓜夾住鹹香的金華火腿，可謂絕配！

programme.title: 匠心築未來粵
programme.desc: 星級藝員阮浩棕親身前往工地，向建造業不同工種的師傅、專才請教及學習，了解燒焊、釘板、紮鐵、混凝土、批盪、油漆、玻璃幕牆、工程監督，各個崗位的工作日常，以及如何善用新科技輔助並完善工序，讓觀眾感受行內專業盡責的匠心、匠技、匠魂與匠行精神。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 健康必殺食粵
programme.desc: 有人無辣不歡，也有人極之怕辣，究竟吃辣對健康可有益處？辣椒含有辣椒素，具抗氧化、抗炎功效，吃籽更可攝取多種營養素。六號與黃婧靈、衍峰和江嘉敏比拼「大話椒」遊戲，要憑對家反應猜出吃辣之人！湛錦鈿教大家自製辣椒醬，還以三色椒焗製芝士中東米。芥末有助抗菌、促進消化，與壽司絕配，婧靈竟挑戰山葵原條吃？薑也是辛辣界代表，有散寒解表、止嘔止咳作用。林凱恩會合嘉敏、婧靈，隨陳國強學煮三薑爆雞球與胡椒芥菜排骨煲。

programme.title: 陪著你走#20粵
programme.desc: (大結局)言重勸加勁日間經營麵檔，重過正常生活。馬拉松舉行當天，天從要言重邊跑邊講戀愛史。天從談到自己的幻想，言重加入幻想，描述如沒得獎的未來。加勁經過琴行，聽見〈陪著你走〉的琴聲並看著一個熟悉的背影在彈琴……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子想吃番薯蛋糕，但媽媽不肯買，她於是想到用舉行讀書會作借口，讓媽媽買蛋糕回來招待朋友。小丸子化身童話故事《不萊梅樂隊》的驢子，與花貓、狗和公雞結伴前往不萊梅溫泉樂園組樂隊謀生。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 雙手打着拍子，跟隨體適能教練的指令做動作，輕鬆訓練四肢協調度，馬上「WORKOUT 2GETHER」！拍完手臂，輪到大腿和腳跟，熟習後可增加難度，挑戰自己。雙手開合的同時，做踢腿或交叉跳，也考驗平衡力。接着以水樽做鍛練，有助提升全身肌力。試試規律地搖動水樽，形成「水龍捲」；蹲下，把水樽向下丟，能讓水樽立在地上嗎？再往斜上方舉高手，試試將水樽從手掌滾向肩膊。過程中難免會掉下水樽，但持續練習總可成功。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 第一學期最後一天，學生會告知陽葵，她們對陽葵的栽培宣告結束，前提是必須通過最終測試，而題目是做出比偶像公主大賽奪冠時更驚艷的演唱會。陽葵獲准與美月、阿紡三人一起接受測試，三人便開始為測試費煞思量……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 睡一覺好的，聽起來很簡單。但不少人卻受長期失眠困擾，眼光光等天光，令身體、情緒大受影響，但旁人卻未必明白箇中苦況。新聞掏寶和大家重溫2004年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 天氣報告粵 及 匠心築未來粵
滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2734粵
programme.desc: 因家人催逼，細曹總要於立春前找到合適的對象，也令他沒心情洽談生意，不肯與家聰簽約。家聰為了討好細曹總，遂答應為他物色對象，並找到一個符合其要求的理想人選。細曹總跟這人本來甚是投緣，詎料……另一方面，細曹總意外被困，幸得某人相救，過程中發現此人並不簡單，因此認定她是其「真命天女」。此人的身分出乎家聰意料，家聰不想她重蹈覆轍，成為細曹總的「受害者」，於是為了幫她而付出一番努力……

programme.title: 非常檢控觀#9粵PG
programme.desc: 遠程、映朱否認與英拔之死有關，英拔的頭骨上卻發現帶有映朱DNA之物。頌星驚訝龐喆獲保釋，龐喆或會阻撓其子包家勉成為醫美集團的行政總裁。映朱指證龐喆是殺人及走私古董的主謀，龐喆再次被捕，他卻早有部署。希仁等查出拍賣行的非法勾當，古董商志健竟參與其中！志健供出英拔慘死的經過；頌星卻向希仁提出質疑……趙舟要希仁暫緩釋放龐喆，更重提他與頌星的舊事。希仁憶及亡兄，借酒澆愁……馨儀設局引出真兇，與其對質……

programme.title: 歡樂茶飯#1粵普PG
programme.desc: 沈家經營飯館，惟生意不佳，便決定把祖宗的故事拍成影片以作宣傳。眾人換上古裝到祖屋兼網紅景點雲水苑拍攝，卻還缺一個壯男飾演祖宗林晏；看見路上有合適的人選，韶光便追上去；經過大門後，卻發現自己已身處古代…

programme.title: 聚大金鳳呈獻:在家宴客60道菜粵
programme.desc: 嘉欣想蒸魚宴客又要有新意，肥媽放進陳皮、欖角滿足其要求。阿媽更貼心分享洗魚的妙招，讓怕腥的客人也能安心享用。邵師傅將薑蔥蟹煮出新高度，加入自製鹹魚醬，令花蟹更添鹹香。嘉欣為了口福忍不住叫「老竇」，所為何事？用鴨煮花膠並非常見做法，鼎爺卻憑深厚中菜經驗，將兩者共冶一爐，煮出鹹香滋味，箇中有甚麼技巧？德哥竟選用臘腸炮製甜品！他將芋頭、番薯炸香後用糖煨煮，再配炸臘腸品嚐，入口帶有豬油甘香。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 名媛望族#33粵
programme.desc: 木水說認罪為保護小由，她卻與啟燊雙宿雙棲，對他不公平，要求小由與他返廣州，二人發生關係。啟燊想起木水說出小由父親名字，懷疑小由已知彼此父親的轇轕。木水叫小由帶小茹與他離開香港，小由堅持要回鍾家交代。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#27粵
programme.desc: 樓上「租霸」徐師奶殺入高家，原來有義收起了徐師奶的拖鞋。徐師奶在夜間遷出該址，留下寫滿詛咒的紙條。溢滿所編的詛咒發生在眾人身上，只得有朋及高麗「身免」。有朋查出全因眾人壞習慣，恐佈繡花鞋竟又再出現。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#38粵普PG
programme.desc: 徐令宜偽裝成黑衣人欲救十一娘，被靖遠候的人窮追不捨，幸得衛國公及彥行相助脫險，但十一娘已行刑在即…原來令宜已把證據呈交給皇上，靖遠候被判死罪，彥行則要流放塞外。仙綾閣名揚海外，十一娘被封一品誥命夫人。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵PG
programme.desc: 一眾超齡學生穿好校服，等待接受校監及校長的任務挑戰！先來個最正常的學術問答比賽，輸者會被扔粉刷，為何最後滿頭白色的會是發問者Bob？用知識「拋書包」後，改用蠻力將書包內物品扔到最遠，誰會勝出？挑戰腰力的蓮步舞比賽，由邵珮詩及丁子朗作「最低決鬥」！球場是學生集中地，戴上望遠鏡踢足球，又有幾多「蝦碌」事情發生？何廣沛與張振朗用射罰球爭出線，有人面子盡失！三分線射球爭奪大利是，哪位是神射手？

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全台首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超群，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 歐若拉公主(完)
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全台首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超群，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全台首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超群，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 那一天，張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫。她眼看著那輛失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她，既沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中。就像鋪天蓋地的穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨過時間的隧道，在一個叫馬爾泰.若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內，重生了…時年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一場震動歷史的「九龍奪嫡」正在暗潮湧動。權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，在被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，張曉，不，是馬爾泰•若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位親王阿哥們交織在一起…她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡的爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有她所愛的，也有愛著她的…若曦最後選擇的究竟是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等歷史的風雲過後，可以陪她看夕陽西下、雲捲雲舒的又將是誰？

programme.title: 歡唱小浣熊

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全台首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超群，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 那一天，張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫。她眼看著那輛失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她，既沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中。就像鋪天蓋地的穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨過時間的隧道，在一個叫馬爾泰.若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內，重生了…時年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一場震動歷史的「九龍奪嫡」正在暗潮湧動。權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，在被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，張曉，不，是馬爾泰•若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位親王阿哥們交織在一起…她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡的爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有她所愛的，也有愛著她的…若曦最後選擇的究竟是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等歷史的風雲過後，可以陪她看夕陽西下、雲捲雲舒的又將是誰？

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S1) - Banana
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say banana and we go on a whirlwind word adventure.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S2) - Snowdens Ear-mergency
programme.desc: Snowden has lost his pine cone ears. Will Messy and his chums find them in time for his performance in the OKIDO Ice Skating Extravaganza?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Joist Hoist
programme.desc: There's a girder out of place on Swoppiton Bridge, and unless Nori can fix it, that bridge is coming down! Luckily, Mojo's got the tops, and Bo's got the skills to help get it done.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Tradies
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo hide under the house and spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard, wondering what they're up to.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Onesies
programme.desc: When mum's sister Brandy comes over for a visit, she brings the kids onesies as a present, which has an unexpected effect on Bingo.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Waiting Badge
programme.desc: When they're accidentally shut in the shed, Duggee shows the Squirrels how to make the time pass with calm breathing and made-up games. The Squirrels cope so well. Does Duggee?

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Cheerleading Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggee's cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. There's a big match ahead...

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Ladybird's Gameshow
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Campfire Choir
programme.desc: Today at Squirrel Club, there are all sorts of comparisons to learn - from small to smallest, hungry to hungriest, and Duggee to Duggiest!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Bullet Train, Japan
programme.desc: All aboard for a high-speed adventure, as the Go Jetters visit Japan's Bullet Train.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - The Dump
programme.desc: On a trip to the Dump, Dad claims he's the best at everything. But Bluey discovers that Dad's throwing out her old drawing and questions if he really is the best Dad in the world.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Mr Monkeyjocks
programme.desc: Dad thinks the kids have too many toys and suggests a chuck out. To save their beloved Mr Monkeyjocks from getting the chop, Bluey and Bingo must prove he is special.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures (S1) - Emperor Penguins
programme.desc: Andy takes Kip on a wild adventure to see emperor penguins in Antarctica. He huddles up in a group of penguins to try and stay warm, and even finds a cosy spot under one of the parents.

programme.title: Dog Squad (S2) - Mission: Fun Run
programme.desc: Rayane's football team are doing a fun run at the park. But when his friend Karim takes a wrong turn, he and his hearing dog Diesel set off in hot pursuit.

programme.title: Aneeshwar and Lizzie Go Wild (S2) - Painted Dog and Coati
programme.desc: This episode features the painted dog and coati - their wild connection is they are both brilliant baby sitters.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Sticks
programme.desc: Bella and Lift play with a stick that makes the perfect magic wand. They visit Patch, who has a tasty recipe - sticky stick critters!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Action Hero Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about an action hero called Jet Rocket.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The What Happened Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels try and tell us what has just happened but are struggling to retell the tale

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Building Block Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels become architects so they can bring to life their very own clubhouse.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Northern Lights, Finland
programme.desc: Ubercorn is excited to see the Northern Lights, but Glitch's Grunge-Grimbler covers them with smoke.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Table Mountain, South Africa
programme.desc: Glitch wants to ski, so the Grimbots give Table Mountain a snowy peak, which threatens its rare plants.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - Thomas and the Royal Engine
programme.desc: An invitation from the Queen sends Thomas and the crew to London as they weave through delays and debacles while racing to a royal celebration.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Cake
programme.desc: Hattie needs help to bake a cake - and Stan's on his way! No challenge is too small or too unusual, and Stan's always happy to lend a hand.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Dinosaur

programme.title: Kazoops! (S1) - Clothes for Jimmy

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S2) - It's Time to Celebrate Diwali

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Musical Statues

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Stories

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Puppets
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Commuting Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Wisdom Badge

programme.desc: After playing in the mud, Monty and Stan decide to give Jimmy Jones a bath, but when Stan can only find one glove from his pair, he tells Monty that half a pair of something is useless, leading Monty to wonder if there are any other uses for a half of a pair.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S2) - It's Time to See the Planets
programme.desc: Captain Chloe's adventures through space inspire JoJo and Gran Gran, who make a visit to the space centre to see the planets.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Turtle Boy
programme.desc: Bingo finds a toy turtle at the playground and wants to take him home, but Dad says it's not the right thing to do.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Onesies
programme.desc: When mum's sister Brandy comes over for a visit, she brings the kids onesies as a present, which has an unexpected effect on Bingo.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Tradies
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo hide under the house and spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard, wondering what they're up to.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Difficult Badge
programme.desc: As the Squirrels appreciate Norrie's new bike, they discover that she doesn't know how to ride it, she finds it too difficult.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The News Badge
programme.desc: After learning that Duggee is making his yearly batch of blueberry jam, a tradition passed on from his great-aunt, the Squirrels decide to spread the news.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Potato Time
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - The Matterhorn, Italy and Switzerland
programme.desc: Glitch gets into a mountain of trouble as the Go Jetters attempt to climb the Matterhorn.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Coconut
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Coconut getting his moment in the limelight with his sea shanty Oh, the Big Waves - if he manages to overcome a little stage fright.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Cranberries
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the bouncing and singing Cranberries!

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Broccoli's Movie Night
programme.desc: Broccoli screens Supertato: The Movie, but Evil Pea has plans to change the story.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - The Tato Team
programme.desc: During the Veggies' Super Sidekick Costume Contest, Evil Pea traps Supertato in a jar of honey. All is lost until the Veggies become real super sidekicks, the Tato Team!

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Noise
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po are trying very hard not to make any noise. Then they make as much noise as possible during the Tubby Phone Dance.

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A professor's assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading to them being relentlessly pursued by the crime syndicate to retrieve the micro-film.

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: The Bully
programme.desc: For lovers of the Shaw's sumptuous production and martial arts expertise, this action adventure in the "Jackie Chan style" is a special treat. A persecuted waiter turns to a "drunken master" for help when a restaurant customer turns out to be a kung-fu harbinger of doom!

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their master's birthday.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlong's younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles...

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern - an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and killings, they realise that it is a trap created to wipe them out once and for all...

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the "sick people of Asia" and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry him-only for her to refuse his proposal.

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry him-only for her to refuse his proposal.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: That Man In Chang-an
programme.desc: The Han Emperor dies and his Empress Lu seizes the ruling power. She plots to kill the heir to the throne, Liu Heng, but the masked warrior discovers her plot and tips off Liu. Liu sends his princess to Chang An to ask for help. The masked warrior protects the princess from attackers along the way and supports Liu to become the new Emperor.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his wife Gan Lian Zhu are the famous "Twin Swords" in the martial arts world. One day, they stumble upon a kidnapping plot at the Red Lotus Temple and Lian Zhu is held captive. Wu successfully escapes to find the Gan family for help, not knowing that he is sending them into an ambush by the kidnappers. Can he finally save Lian Zhu?

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun...

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Lady Of The Law
programme.desc: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponent's son, Yim. While Chan forbids Yim to practice martial arts, Yim secretly learns it. Ten years later, a rapist appears and Yim is arrested by a lady constable as the suspect. The rapist turns out to be Chan's elder son and Yim is framed by the Chans. Can Yim prove his innocence?

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Opium And The Kung-Fu Master
programme.desc: Tie Qiao San, head of the Ten Guangdong Tigers, is an honourable master with many disciples. As opium becomes popular among the nobles, Tie starts taking it and gradually harms his body. When an opium house's owner defeats Tie in a fight and he is only saved from being killed by his disciple, Tie vows to quit opium and get back on his feet.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the men's help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called "Five Poison Web", spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: In this period martial arts thriller, three police graduates are assigned to a town rife with crimes and corruption. They vow to uphold justice but are hampered by their corrupt superior, resulting in them putting their lives and the lives of their beloved in danger.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: In this surprisingly light-hearted "Venoms" martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case...

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: Hao Shi becomes the new triad boss after his father is killed by the pretty swindler, Ling. While professional gunman Drunken Gun is tasked to help Hao Shi take revenge, Ling is hunted by gangster Lei, from whom she has conned 2 million dollars. In the process, Hao Shi and Drunken Gun accidentally arrest Lei instead...

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Ninth Happiness
programme.desc: A comedy starring many popular movie stars, this is a story about a magistrate and his brothers aiming to introduce sin and romance into the virtuous community of Rainbow Village. As they vie for the affections of a charming young village maiden, conflicts arise, adding a twist to their mischievous endeavours.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Eddie is hired by the Interpol to capture a human smuggling gang leader known as Snakehead. Eddie dies in an action to protect a sacred child from being kidnapped, but is brought back to life by the child's magical medallion, allowing him to finally kill Snakehead.

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from To's father and bitter jealousy from her designated fiance, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II
programme.desc: After being betrayed by Zhuo, the white-haired witch Lian seeks revenge by slaughtering her way through the eight martial arts clans. However, she is soon attacked by a man whose bride she has abducted. Meanwhile, Zhuo, who is waiting on a hilltop for a flower to bloom for Lian's restoration, hastens to save her upon realizing the danger she is in.

programme.title: Heaven in the Dark
programme.desc: Michelle files for sexual harassment charges against Pastor To after they shared a passionate kiss, and this turns into a bitter court case. The pastor turns away from his faith thereafter, while Michelle becomes even more religious. When they meet again 5 years later, both of them realize that they have still not gotten over the incident.

programme.title: Heaven in the Dark
programme.desc: Michelle files for sexual harassment charges against Pastor To after they shared a passionate kiss, and this turns into a bitter court case. The pastor turns away from his faith thereafter, while Michelle becomes even more religious. When they meet again 5 years later, both of them realize that they have still not gotten over the incident.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: The Chinese Feast
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Wo Hu
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Police has placed more than a thousand undercover officers in various triad groups to bring down the largest criminal organization in Hong Kong. Betrayal, deceit and murder bring this group of "brothers" into a collision with the law and with each other!

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: The Story of Woo Viet
programme.desc: Former Vietnamese veteran Woo Viet arrives a refugee camp in Hong Kong and meets his pen pal Quan. Subsequently, he encounters Shum Ching, with whom he attempts to flee to the US. However, the pair end up stranded in Manila's Chinatown, where at the hands of the local triads Woo becomes a hired killer, while Shum is forced into prostitution.

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters' best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: To the Fore
programme.desc: The cycling team's top sprinter Zheng Zi Yuan teams up with two domestiques, Ming and Tian, who assist him to win the race. When Ming and Tian get tired of sacrificing their own chances to win, an accident causes the team to break up but the trio soon team up again for another race. Who will be the first to cross the line this time?

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: Young priest Hong disguises himself to protect Bai, a prostitute, while Detective Liu investigates her ties to a prostitution ring. Hong finds Bai a lawful job and helps her negotiate with the underworld. Meanwhile, Liu's investigation causes misunderstandings - can he crack down on the gang? How will Hong manage his emotions as Bai falls for him?

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Ka Shing meets Kitty one day and they fall quickly in love. However, Kitty disappears shortly and when they meet years later, she is already married. To comfort himself, Ka Shing asks a mystic master to let Kitty appear in his dreams so that he can be with her constantly, even though she can only be his dream lover...

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Model from Hell
programme.desc: Anna, an exceptional student in a modelling school, becomes the target of envy from fellow models, who all die mysteriously when they want to harm her. It turns out that when Anna is upset, she undergoes a terrifying transformation and can wield lethal psychic power...

programme.title: Man Wanted 3
programme.desc: Street kid Dong idolizes Mongkok triad leader Pu Jun and inadvertently joins his gang. When rival Xi Yang seizes control by illicit means, Pu Jun decides to take him down. At the same time, Pu Jun uncovers Dong as a police undercover and banishes him, but Dong sheds his undercover identity to join Pu Jun to seek revenge against Xi Yang.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: As Wudang disciple Zhuo Yi Hang confronts the Demon Palace, he reunites with Lian Ni Shang, the woman who once saved him, and their love reignites. Lian, a disciple of the Demon Palace, endures torment to be with Zhuo but is shattered when he accidentally injures her. A fierce battle between good and evil unfolds!

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 3
programme.desc: Gambling tycoon Man suddenly marries his new partner Sophie, which shocked his only son, Ken. In the wake of Man's heart attack, Ken must battle Sophie - who has persuaded Man to transfer his grand master title to her in the event of his death - for the rightful claim to the family's gambling business in a riveting game of mahjong.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddy's career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation...

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Wingmen
programme.desc: When unexpected guests arrive bringing AAARRRGGHHs past and illness to light Jim finds himself competing in a terrifying game of Pyrobligst.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Angor Management
programme.desc: Jim and Strickler team up to bring down Angor Rot Meanwhile the Gnome returns with important information regarding Baby Enrique.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - A Night To Remember
programme.desc: Jim must convince Strickler to cut the bond to his mom while Claire and Toby sneak into his office during the Spring Fling Dance for the incantation.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Thunder Games
programme.desc: When Gran announces it’s time to choose a new Thunder Sisters Queen, Ugga assumes she’s got it in the bag. But after a series of challenges (the Thunder Games), it becomes clear Gran might not be ready to step down.

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - Viking For Hire
programme.desc: Now that dragon-killing is no longer necessary, Hiccup tries to find a new job for Gobber the Blacksmith, but the task proves harder than expected.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S3 - Knights of Light (Part 1)
programme.desc: With Allura as their guide, the Paladins embark on a dangerous journey into Honerva’s mindspace to uncover her final plan.

programme.title: Harvey Girls Forever! S2 - Wacky Weekday Hike Caramba!
programme.desc: The Harvey Girls are splitting up for the day, but they've accidentally swapped suitcases -- and personalities! Dot trains to become a Trout Master.

programme.title: Dinotrux Supercharged S3 - Goldtrux
programme.desc: Waldos new fancy gadget gets noticed by a truck who is obsessed with gold and only in it for himself

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - Amazamoose and Squirrel Wonder: Chapter Two
programme.desc: When a mysterious goop gives Fearless Leader real life superpowers, Rocky and Bullwinkle must reprise their masked hero personas.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can We Make The Most Beautiful Garden Ever?
programme.desc: Poor Mimi! Her normally beautiful garden is all messy and full of swirly piles of earth. She's really upset and Jess promises to her help her make it the most beautiful garden ever! Raking away the swirls doesn't work, they just come back! Jess and Mimi realise that worms are making the swirly piles of earth. Mimi wants to move them away but they go back underground before she can catch them.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - Why Are There Little Hills In The Orchard?
programme.desc: Jess and the pups have been looking after the orchard while Willow's been on holiday but the day she's due back the orchard is full of little piles of earth. What's making them? That's the Big Question. Jess wonders if someone put them there. He asks Mimi, who's making a pile of earth while she digs a hole. She tells him she's going to plant an apple tree. Maybe someone's been planting new apple trees in the orchard thinks Jess.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - Why Are There So Many Ladybirds?
programme.desc: One winter morning Jess finds lots of ladybird in his barn. Why are they there? That's the Big Question! Mimi tells him that she has lots of ladybirds in her garden in the summer. They're always hungry and brilliant for the plants because they eat all the greenfly. Maybe they're looking for greenfly in his barn? Jess doesn't think so. There are no greenfly in the barn. He goes to ask Baa and Billie for help.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can I Stop Little Bird Eating The Seeds?
programme.desc: Mimi's really upset with Little Bird who keeps eating all her lettuce seeds. Jess wonders how they can stop her. They try putting out extra food for her but Little Bird just eats everything! Jess wonders if covering the seeds with something so that Little Bird can't reach them would work. Mimi says it's a good idea but the sun won't reach the seeds either - which means they won't grow. The only thing that seems to stop t Little Bird is when she sees Jess and is frightened away.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can I Go Up And Down On The See-Saw?
programme.desc: Baa and Billie have built a fantastic new see-saw in the meadow. Jess can't wait to have a go. But when he tries to make it go up and down with him on one end and Baa and Billie on the other he just gets stuck in the air and can't get the see saw down. ‘How can I go up and down on the see saw?' he asks? -desperate to have all the ‘up and down' fun he see the puppies having when they jump on the see-saw.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - What Can I Do With My Nature Collection?
programme.desc: Jess shows Mimi his lovely Nature Collection. She really likes it and wonders what he's going to do with it. Now that's a good question! Jess thinks he'll display it but with the pups racing around it'd soon get damaged. He asks Horace if he could use it to make musical instruments, some things make a great sound but others aren't so good. It's time to go on a picnic with Mimi and his friends.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Power Outage Part 3 + 4

They also educate people on how to preserve Taiwan's beautiful and gifted environment.
